description: List the layers of a Denver ArcGIS service (for discovery). Pass a known short name (crime) or a full ArcGIS service path (e.g. "ODC_CRIME_OFFENSES_P/FeatureServer"). Omit `service` to list the known Denver services. Returns layer id + name to use with denver_query.

service.description: Short name (crime) or full ArcGIS service path. Omit to list known services.

name: denver_layers
title: Denver Layers
